svg.text: Indicative only, never firm unless PeakPower says so. Every price is the market quote plus PeakPower’s markup — currently 2,0 %. A firm price is issued only when you request a trade.

svg.text: A price becomes firm only when PeakPower issues an offer against your trade request, and it is then time-limited.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every indication is the market quote plus PeakPower’s markup — reference data, currently 2,0 %. The raw market price is never shown.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No price history is kept in the portal: no trend chart, no comparison with earlier days.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Prices cannot be downloaded, exported or read over the API. Your own usage data can be.
